Does the 14 April date work on your end given any downstream plans you have tied to launch?

We appreciate your patience as we work through this final step, and we remain committed to delivering a fully certified, high-quality result. Please let us know if you would like to schedule a call to discuss the revised timeline or any related details in the meantime.
